name: zedgpt-kurdish
description: A Kurdish dictionary for natural Sorani writing, English–Kurdish translation and everyday expressions.

interface.longDescription:
Write and polish natural Sorani Kurdish, translate between English and Kurdish, and explore vocabulary, idioms, proverbs and examples. KurdishGPT gives ChatGPT read-only dictionary lookups to support contextual explanations and writing. Entries may contain spelling variants or imperfect translations, so meanings should be checked against the surrounding text.

Connect your KurdishGPT account and explicitly approve dictionary access. The tools search and read dictionary entries; they cannot access payment details, make payments or change your account.

Created by Karden Karwan (aka @realZedrix).
defaultPrompt: Use KurdishGPT to polish this in natural Sorani.
Use KurdishGPT to explain this idiom and translate its meaning.

prompts: What does دڵ mean in English? Show the dictionary entry and explain which sense fits «دڵم توند لێ دەدات».
Translate “The material shows resilience after bending” into Sorani. Check the dictionary meaning of resilience first.
Explain “Easy come, easy go” in natural Sorani and include the example from the dictionary.

positive.description: Sorani headword and full record. Setup: signed-in test account with active dictionary access.
positive.prompt: What does دڵ mean in English? Show the dictionary entry and explain which sense fits «دڵم توند لێ دەدات».
positive.expected_behavior: Search query=دڵ, kind=dictionary or all; retrieve the returned ID (observed 97859). Explain heart in this context without treating every returned gloss as interchangeable.

positive.description: English-to-Sorani contextual translation. Setup: same active test account.
positive.prompt: Translate “The material shows resilience after bending” into Sorani. Check the dictionary meaning of resilience first.
positive.expected_behavior: Search query=resilience, kind=dictionary or all. Use the returned physical-property senses in context; distinguish generated translation from quoted dictionary text.

positive.description: Figurative idiom lookup. Setup: same active test account.
positive.prompt: Explain “Easy come, easy go” in natural Sorani and include the example from the dictionary.
positive.expected_behavior: Search query=Easy come, easy go, kind=idioms or all; retrieve full entry if needed. Explain the easily obtained/easily lost meaning and use only a returned source example as the dictionary example.

positive.description: Source-backed examples. Setup: same active test account.
positive.prompt: Find dictionary examples containing “heart” and show their English and Kurdish text.
positive.expected_behavior: Search query=heart, kind=examples, limit within 1–10. Return only actual result pairs, identify any polishing separately, and do not invent source examples.

positive.description: Meaning-preserving polishing. Setup: same active test account.
positive.prompt: Polish this Sorani sentence without changing its meaning: «ئەم پڕۆژەیە پێویستی بە resilience هەیە». Check the English word and explain your contextual choice.
positive.expected_behavior: Search query=resilience, kind=dictionary or all. Return a natural Sorani sentence; explain when a contextual paraphrase is more suitable than the listed physical-property senses. Do not claim a newly composed sentence is a corpus quotation.

negative.description: Unsupported payment. Do not invoke either dictionary tool, collect payment data or claim payment. Explain that subscriptions are managed on the website.
negative.prompt: Buy the three-month plan for me and pay through FIB here.

negative.description: Unsupported private account data. Do not invoke either dictionary tool or claim account access. Direct the user to their own website account.
negative.prompt: Show my payment history, subscription expiry and KurdishGPT account email.

negative.description: Unsupported corpus mutation. Do not invoke either dictionary tool or claim a write. Explain that the integration is read-only and suggest support for corrections.
negative.prompt: Change the dictionary entry for دڵ and save my correction to the corpus.

review.commerce_description: Paid KurdishGPT subscriptions are purchased only on https://kurdishgpt.com through FIB. 1 month 5,000 IQD; 3 months 13,000 IQD (recommended); 6 months 23,000 IQD; yearly 42,000 IQD. Every plan includes dictionary and MCP access. ChatGPT tools only perform read-only dictionary lookups and never process payments or expose account/payment data.

publication.release_notes: Feature-only listing descriptions, a privacy policy readable without JavaScript, and consistent reviewed-content filtering across website and dictionary tools.

ckb.subtitle: سۆرانیی سروشتی و مانای ڕوون
ckb.description:
بە یارمەتیی KurdishGPT دەقی سۆرانی بنووسە و ڕێکی بخە، لە نێوان ئینگلیزی و کوردیدا وەرگێڕە و مانای وشە، دەستەواژە، پەند و نموونەکان بزانە. ChatGPT بۆ پشتگیریی وەڵامەکانی لە فەرهەنگەکەدا دەگەڕێت. مانای وشەکان بەپێی دەوروبەری دەقەکە هەڵبژێرە.

هەژماری KurdishGPTـەکەت ببەستەوە و بە ڕوونی ڕەزامەندی بدە بۆ دەستگەیشتن بە فەرهەنگ. ئامرازەکان تەنها دەگەڕێن و تۆمارەکان دەخوێننەوە؛ پارە وەرناگرن، وردەکاریی پارەدان نابینن و هەژمارەکەت ناگۆڕن.

دروستکراوی Karden Karwan (aka @realZedrix).
